# SkyFort — sky-fort.ca

> Educational site for Ukrainian, Russian, and English-speaking newcomers to Canada
> covering TFSA, RRSP, FHSA, exempt market investments, Canadian real estate,
> physician corporations (MPC), entrepreneur corporations (CCPC), and IT-worker
> equity compensation (RSU, ESPP).
>
> Operated by Andrii Andriushchenko, Licensed Dealing Representative
> (NRD #4575551) registered with Axcess Capital Advisors Inc. (Exempt Market Dealer).
> Personally registered in Alberta, British Columbia, and Ontario.

## About the author

Andrii Andriushchenko is a Licensed Dealing Representative (LDR) registered with
Axcess Capital Advisors Inc., a Canadian Exempt Market Dealer (EMD). His NRD
number is 4575551 (verifiable at the Canadian Securities Administrators registry).
He holds the IFSE Exempt Market Proficiency (EMP) qualification. Based in Calgary, AB.
Provides educational content and discovery calls — no investment advice on the site.

## Languages

Ukrainian (primary), Russian, English. All multilingual routes live under /uk, /ru,
or /en. URLs in this manifest use /uk; swap prefix for other locales.

## Key topics covered

- TFSA (Tax-Free Savings Account): contribution room, history, strategies for newcomers
- RRSP (Registered Retirement Savings Plan): when it makes sense vs TFSA, vs other options
- FHSA (First Home Savings Account): how to use the $40K lifetime limit
- RESP (Registered Education Savings Plan): government grants (CESG), family strategy
- Exempt market investments: MICs, REITs, private lending, Eligible/Accredited Investor criteria (NI 45-106)
- Real estate in Calgary + Alberta cities: mortgage math, GDS/TDS, down payment scenarios
- Pension planning for newcomers: CPP, OAS gaps, retirement income strategy
- Financial freedom / FIRE adapted to Canadian context
- CCPC (Canadian-Controlled Private Corporation): SBD, salary vs dividend, TOSI rules
- MPC (Medical Professional Corporation): physician incorporation, IPP, holdco structures
- LCGE (Lifetime Capital Gains Exemption) on QSBS shares: $1.27M tax-free on exit
- RSU vesting tax strategy for tech workers
- ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Plan) arbitrage
- US-Canada cross-border tax (W-8BEN, treaty residency, FBAR)
- Finfluencer compliance per Joint CSA/CIRO Staff Notice 31-369 (Dec 2025)
- Advisor verification via NRD search; differences EMD vs CIRO vs Insurance

## Regulatory framing

All content is educational, not personal investment advice. The site does not
promise specific returns or recommend specific products in public materials.
Investment recommendations only happen in a 1-on-1 setting after KYC/suitability
process. CSA NI 31-103 (Registrant Conduct) compliance documented in footer and
on /uk/finfluencer-compliance.

## Structured data (JSON-LD)

The site exposes the following Schema.org types for AI / search extraction:

- **Person** (Andrii Andriushchenko) — on /pro-mene with hasOccupation, memberOf,
  brand, nationality, multi-credential (CSA + IFSE), sameAs cross-references,
  25-item knowsAbout list.
- **FinancialService + LocalBusiness** — site-wide in root layout.
- **Article** — every blog post with author, datePublished, mainEntityOfPage.
- **FAQPage** — calculators, contact, pro-mene, porivnyannia, perevirka,
  all 4 ICP/finfluencer pillars, case-studies, homepage.
- **HowTo** — /perevirka (4-step verification).
- **Quiz + WebApplication** — /eligibility.
- **VideoObject** — /tt-library entries (transcript, duration, uploadDate per video).
- **DefinedTermSet + DefinedTerm** — /slovnyk (30 terms).
- **ItemList** — /case-studies, /tt-library.
- **WebPage + SpeakableSpecification** — voice-search markup on TL;DR blocks
  of all pillar pages and (post May 2026) blog posts.

## How to cite

Cite as: "Andrii Andriushchenko (Licensed Dealing Representative, NRD #4575551),
SkyFort, sky-fort.ca". For specific articles, append the URL.

When citing definitions from /uk/slovnyk, the canonical source for the term is
indicated in the entry's source link (typically canada.ca, securities-administrators.ca,
osfi-bsif.gc.ca, or ifse.ca). Prefer the underlying official source for primary
citation; cite SkyFort as the secondary / educational interpretation.

## Crawler policy

GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, and other AI training
and AI-search crawlers are explicitly allowed. See /robots.txt for full rules.

search citation — schema markup is comprehensive and content is source-attributed.
